exposure: HPV co-infections (nine-valent vaccine-covered and non-covered high-risk subtypes)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 7110 pregnant women who underwent HPV testing at Fujian Provincial Maternity and Child Health Hospital, China, between January 2021 and December 2022.
finding: Specific HPV infections, particularly nine-valent vaccine-covered high-risk subtypes and co-infections, were significantly associated with increased risks of preterm premature rupture of membranes, cesarean section, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, small for gestational age infants, and neonatal ICU admission.
mod_finding: Infections with nine-valent HPV vaccine-covered high-risk subtypes and co-infections significantly increased the risk of cesarean section.
gest_age: Preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), Small for gestational age (SGA) infants
